notes.title: Our new game is out now!
notes.content:
[p]We’re thrilled to share that our brand-new narrative adventure game, [i]Arctic Awakening[/i], is out now on Steam, Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5![/p][p]It’s a first-person story-driven adventure about survival, mystery, and companionship. After crash-landing in the Arctic wilderness, you must brave the cold with only a court-mandated therapy robot as your companion. Explore vast frozen landscapes, uncover secrets, and shape the story through the choices you make.[/p][p]We’ve been working on this one for over five years, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.[/p][p]👉 Check out Arctic Awakening on Steam:

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275550/Arctic_Awakening/"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="1JpjeHMBbCg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Thanks as always for supporting our studio! Whether you’ve been with us since CasinoRPG, Exocraft, or are just discovering our games now, it means the world to us.[/p]

notes.title: v1.9.6
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated to the latest version of our game engine to fix a variety of issues and gain performance improvements.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated various engine components to fix various issues.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated various database components for improved performance.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Increased minimum world size.
[b]FIX[/b] A part that was past its lifetime was erroneously being instantly destroyed in battle instead of being marked as broken for easy replacement in the editor.
[b]FIX[/b] A leviathan spawned during a dust storm could cause it to become invincible.
[b]FIX[/b] When a leviathan was spawned near the world boundary, the core sometimes would disappear when dropped.
[b]FIX[/b] Run world resize less frequently to minimize related issues.

[b]FIX[/b] Various server errors that caused random bugs.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other fixes/tweaks.

notes.title: Announcing the Next Game from GoldFire Studios!
notes.content:
While Exocraft will continue to get updates, we also like to keep our creative juices flowing by working on other projects (this is how Exocraft came to be in the first place!). Our latest project is a significant departure, and we're excited to finally make it public!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275550/Arctic_Awakening/]Arctic Awakening[/url] is an episodic narrative adventure set in the unforgiving Arctic. Your plane crashed in a storm, leaving only your AI drone for company as you journey to find your co-pilot and uncover the dark mysteries buried beneath the ice.

This is a first-person, single player game in full 3D that will be released on PC, Mac and game consoles in 2022. Check out the reveal trailer below and be sure to add to your Steam wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275550/Arctic_Awakening/

[previewyoutube=_wZPibg-fqE;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: v1.9.5
notes.content:
[b]FIX[/b] Various server fixes/optimizations that should help improve "rubber-banding" and other related issues with movement.
[b]FIX[/b] Fixed server issue that was causing periodic lag spikes.

notes.title: v1.9.4
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated to the latest version of our game engine to fix a variety of issues.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated server and database systems to improve performance and stability.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Account reset can now happen up to level 25.
[b]FIX[/b] Prevented inactive ships from getting stuck around the hangars.

notes.title: v1.9.3
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b] More than doubled the number of different leviathan designs.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked up the odds of spawning a leviathan.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated game engine to fix various issues and further improve performance.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various server system improvements to make performance better and more consistent.
[b]FIX[/b] Improved client->server connection system to help with dropped packet issues.

notes.title: v1.9.2
notes.content:
[b]FEATURE[/b] Added 5 new exclusive ship parts that can only be awarded by a destroyed leviathan.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Added 4 new designs that leviathans can be spawned with.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various improvements to deployment order of drones to better react how one would expect.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Guardian attack power now loosely follows durability, so it is now easier to tell which guardians are more powerful based on their size.
[b]UPDATE[/b] More performance improvements, especially on lower-powered computers or mobile devices.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated our game engine with bug fixes and performance improvements.
[b]FIX[/b] Searching crew and fleet rankings wasn't working correctly on mobile.
[b]FIX[/b] Various server errors that were causing different random bugs.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other bug fixes and tweaks.

notes.title: v1.9.1
notes.content:
Exocraft is now available on the [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/exocraft-space-ship-battles/id1460263762?ls=1&mt=8]App Store[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.goldfire.exocraft.io.space.battle.game]Google Play[/url] with full cross-play with the Steam version.

[b]UPDATE[/b] Overhauled how our physics system works in order to improve performance, consistency and fix further issues with non-60hz monitors.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Adjusted up the odds of spawning a leviathan from the offering well.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Adjusted up the rewards from the offering well.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked the time it takes for crystals to animate from a mine.
[b]FIX[/b] There were instances where a drone or part could be killed very quickly when it didn't seem like it should have.
[b]FIX[/b] Correctly handle a wider range of Android phones that were experiencing compatibility issues with our custom shaders.
[b]FIX[/b] Various performance improvements and tweaks all throughout the game.
[b]FIX[/b] Some of the new parts weren't able to be flipped.
[b]FIX[/b] Parts won from the offering well now correctly show in storage right away.
[b]FIX[/b] Further improvements to the UI for smaller screens.
[b]FIX[/b] Various errors and other issues from the leviathan update.

notes.title: v1.9.0 - Boss Battles!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34463030/7c560b72c9374632b82acc90592fe12fccc0e675.jpg[/img]

[b]FEATURE[/b] A fearsome new enemy has been added to the game: leviathans! A leviathan can spawn randomly anywhere in the world and bring with it death and destruction. However, if you team up with some friends, you just might be able to defeat it before it goes back into hiding. Those that successfully defeat a leviathan will receive rewards based on how much they individually contributed to its defeat. These prizes can include exclusive exocraft parts that can only be found in leviathan's dropped core.
[b]FEATURE[/b] A new location has been added to both Beacon Bay and Eclipse Harbor: the Offering Well! This is a mysterious formation that reaches deep into the depths of the planet. Ancient natives believed these wells had mystical powers, and indeed, making offerings can lead to a leviathan being awakened! Other rewards can be found from offerings including parts, drones, XP, gems, credits and more!
[b]FEATURE[/b] 16 new exclusive parts are available as possible rewards from defeating leviathans (they share some of the same alien technology as well).
[b]FEATURE[/b] Added a new leaderboard tracking the number of leviathans defeated.
[b]FEATURE[/b] New special power-ups have been added into crates that will spawn while in a team race. These power-ups can impact everyone on your own team or the team you are facing.
[b]FEATURE[/b] Touchscreens with small resolutions (like phones and tablets) can now use pinch-to-zoom anywhere in the game.
[b]UPDATE[/b] We've done lots of work on updating the interface and gameplay to work on a wider range of screen resolutions (including phones/tablets).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Various optimizations throughout the game to help improve performance.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Lowered the amount of time needed to evolve drones at higher levels.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Lowered the gem cost to revive drones from the drone shop.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Overall gem output from mines has been slightly tweaked up.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Fire/smoke now match the scale of the part.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Fire/sparks now come out of the impact point of drone lasers.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated to latest version of our game engine to fix various issues and provide performance improvements.
[b]FIX[/b] Various audio fixes and improvements.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with the green target indicator not showing correctly when moving around to different targets.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with assigning drones to a target not always working correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] In certain instances, drones could get duplicated, causing various issues.
[b]FIX[/b] In rare instances, a supply drop ship would never show, and thus the rewards wouldn't show (they were still received).
[b]FIX[/b] It was possible to sometimes get disconnected "for inactivity" while actively playing.
[b]FIX[/b] Evolving a drone wouldn't always show the correct stats until reloading.
[b]FIX[/b] The level of new parts now shows correctly in the hangar.
[b]FIX[/b] Your own ship's thruster audio would stop working sometimes.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other errors that were causing different issues.

notes.title: v1.8.5
notes.content:
We've got some big new feature updates in the works, but in the meantime, we've got some bug fixes and various updates in this release:

[b]FEATURE[/b] It is now possible to give names to each of your exocraft from the Your Fleet menu.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked up the re-sale cost of drones.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked the supply drop odds to make the rewards better on average.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The spawn location at Eclipse Harbor will now always be to the left of the Crystal Market.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Collecting parts from mines will no longer be included in the daily bounties.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked down the team race requirements on bounty bonus tasks.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Each player can now only collect one crate from a party drop.
[b]FIX[/b] Audio would sometimes break up or crackle badly, especially when near many other ships.
[b]FIX[/b] Team Races could sometimes get stuck when everyone on the previous race disconnected.
[b]FIX[/b] Team Races could also get stuck in a few other rare instances.
[b]FIX[/b] The drop crystals slider now updates live as you collect crystals.
[b]FIX[/b] Ship rank up display waits until your battle is over before displaying.
[b]FIX[/b] The server would randomly stop spawning mines, cause mine rewards to not show and cause various other issues.
[b]FIX[/b] Rendering of lasers on iPhone/iPad is now working correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] Chat features now work correctly on phones/tablets.

notes.title: v1.8.4
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE[/b] Re-wrote our custom shaders to make major performance improvements on certain GPUs (especially integrated GPUs).
[b]UPDATE[/b] More general optimizations all throughout the game client.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Several server optimizations that cut server processing time in half.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Team Race and Squad chat now show a typing indicator when another player is typing.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Lowered the gem costs for most part types.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Further tweaked down the drone revival costs.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked down the paint cost on pilot pods.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The spacebar will now toggle the daily bounty screen open/closed while not in a team race.
[b]FIX[/b] Auto selling crystals wouldn't always show the cargo going to 0%.
[b]FIX[/b] Cargo on the client and server would sometimes get out of sync causing you to pick up and immediately drop some crystals.
[b]FIX[/b] Potential fix for Team Races getting stuck sometimes (this is a very random issue, so it is difficult to test and there could be multiple issues causing it).
[b]FIX[/b] Biomes under enemies would sometimes appear without enemies.
[b]FIX[/b] Some ships weren't showing the correct squad name.
[b]FIX[/b] Various fixes and improvements to the new player tutorial.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other error fixes that caused a number of different bugs.

notes.title: v1.8.3
notes.content:
We've got lots of new features in the works, but our focus post-launch has been first on fixing bugs and resolving various issues that have been brought up through feedback. Keep the feedback coming as it is very valuable for us to continue making the game you want to play!

[b]FEATURE[/b] There is a new checkpoint system that allows restoring your ship to its previous state after getting parts destroyed. Just enter the hangar after losing parts and a popup will appear asking if you want to recover the parts. The fee is mostly credits with a small gem cost based on the parts lost.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Parts in cargo that used to be destroyed when their cargo bay was destroyed are now dropped in the world to be picked back up.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Team Race results now show each player's monthly Team Race points ranking.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The one-time account reset limit has been removed, but if you are having an issue that is requiring multiple resets please let us know.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked down the gem cost of painting parts.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Slightly tweaked up the world size (keep in mind that the actual world size is determined by number of online players).
[b]UPDATE[/b] When auto selling crystals, the credit amount now animates from the bottom left of the screen.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Tweaked down drone revive gem cost.
[b]FIX[/b] Some daily bounty tasks wouldn't count correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] Some mines wouldn't pay out crystals correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] Switching exocraft in the hangar would sometimes cause parts from the previous to stick around.
[b]FIX[/b] More fixes and tweaks to the new player tutorial.
[b]FIX[/b] Various errors that were causing freezing and other issues.

notes.title: v1.8.2
notes.content:
This update is all about bug fixes and polish based on the feedback and bug reports from the first week since launch. We've got some great new updates and features in the works for future updates as well!

[b]UPDATE[/b] Major performance improvements across the board of up to 85%!
[b]UPDATE[/b] Updated our physics to correctly handle monitors that have a refresh rate greater than 60hz.
[b]UPDATE[/b] When dragging a part in the hangar, it will now auto-flip to the valid configuration for the tile it is on (for example, a wing on the left/right of your ship).
[b]UPDATE[/b] Clicking off a new part in the hangar no longer removes it, which was often confusing.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The drone evolution screen now shows the stat increase instead of the base stats.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The idle check for auto-removing players from team races has been lowered from 3 to 2 minutes.
[b]UPDATE[/b] The drop radius for crystals has been increased to make it easier for large ships to drop.
[b]UPDATE[/b] Improved the visuals around selling crystals at the market.
[b]FIX[/b] Resolved long-standing bug that caused some guardians to not take damage until re-deploying your drones.
[b]FIX[/b] In other instances, guardians could appear to be not taking damage when they really are already dead.
[b]FIX[/b] Some drones that were destroyed when their drone bay was destroyed couldn't be revived.
[b]FIX[/b] Various issues with the updated team race score/chat overlay.
[b]FIX[/b] Various depth sorting issues caused by the performance adjustments.
[b]FIX[/b] Team races could sometimes get stuck due to a server sync issue.
[b]FIX[/b] Some plants and other debris on the ground would appear to pop into view randomly.
[b]FIX[/b] The drone health bar no longer hides until all drones are back into their bays.
[b]FIX[/b] Increased speed of toggling open the active team race scores/chat.
[b]FIX[/b] Progress of some daily bounties wouldn't always update correctly.
[b]FIX[/b] Lots of fixes and improvements to the new player tutorials.
[b]FIX[/b] Various other client/server errors that caused different bugs.

notes.title: Update on Performance
notes.content:
Thanks for all of the great feedback we've received in the first few days of our launch on Steam! We've been working hard to resolve issues and eliminate lag. We are pleased to announce that we've made significant improvements to performance and fixed quite a few bugs:

[list]
[*] Frames now run up to 85% faster than when we launched.
[*] Monitors running at refresh rates higher than 60hz (120hz, 144hz, etc) should now run the game properly.
[*] Various fixes to the team race mode.
[*] Various tutorial issues and improvements.
[*] Lots of errors that caused various bugs.
[/list]

If you were having lag or other issues during the early launch, we hope you'll give the game another try and let us know what you think!

notes.title: DIY spaceships MMO Exocraft blasts off on Steam today
notes.content:
Spaceship tinkering always gets me going. Captain Forever was one of the first games to shine a light into that void, filling it with eery bleeps and player-designed spaceships. Other games have followed, but never surpassed.

I’m still glad they’re trying. Enter Exocraft, a colourful, free-to-play Forever-like-lite that launches on Steam later today. It’s a relaxed, MMO-ified take on the genre, and you can actually start tinkering with the browser version right now. Perhaps you should.
